description: Northrop Grumman Corporation is a leading global aerospace and defense technology company that delivers a broad range of products, services and solutions to U.S. and international customers, and principally to the U.S. Department of War and the intelligence community. Its broad portfolio is aligned to support national security priorities and its solutions equip customers with the capabilities they need to connect, protect and advance humanity, and it is a leading provider of space systems, military aircraft, missile defense, advanced weapons and long-range fires capabilities, mission systems, networking and communications, strategic deterrence systems, and breakthrough technologies such as advanced computing, microelectronics and cyber, focusing on competing and winning programs that enable continued growth, performing on its commitments and affordably delivering the capability its customers need.
